messages.subject: Project Umbra - AtlasMRV licence to Hollencroft
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

As discussed, we want to license the AtlasMRV platform and the patent family to Hollencroft Industrial Group so they can embed it in their supply-chain reporting product. Exclusive within that field, royalty-bearing. Can Whitfield Carter act for us on the licence? Sofia (GC) will be your day-to-day contact alongside me.

Henry

messages.plaintextBody:
Henry,

Delighted to. I'll lead with Elena Marchetti as associate. First step is a mutual NDA before we share any patent or source detail. Draft attached - please have Sofia sign and we'll countersign. We'll open the matter as Project Umbra (ref SW/EM/CAS-UMBRA).

Best,
Sarah
